lastEvent.text: Thieves broke in overnight. Repairs and replacement kit cost £1,500.

log.title: Legacy software Ltd is incorporated
log.text: Medium difficulty. You hold 100% of the shares and £50,000 in the bank. Sell a subscription product to small businesses. No inventory, ~88% gross margin, but developers are expensive and customers churn if the product falls behind. 30% of customers prepay annually, creating deferred revenue.

log.title: Interest rate rise
log.text: Base rate rises 0.75% to 4.75%. Loans, leases and overdrafts cost more, and your DCF discount rate rises.

log.title: Interest rate cut
log.text: Base rate falls 0.5% to 4.25%. Borrowing is cheaper and valuations rise.

log.title: Viral review
log.text: A glowing review goes viral. Brand +60 points and reputation +3.

log.title: Supply chain disruption
log.text: Shipping and input costs jump. Unit costs +20% until supply recovers: watch your gross margin. Expected to last about 4 months.

log.title: New financial year
log.text: Salaries rose 3% with inflation. New acquisition targets are available in the M&A tab.
